archive.catalogue_description: What up everyone. I would like to start off by saying this is my first “Try” at a map I tried to eliminate all glitches but if there are any that I have missed please leave a reply. This is a somewhat small map but I tried my best. The map includes -A zombie counter -4 original perks -Black ops quick revive -Pack-a-Punch -Buyable ending -Mystery box Plus a little secret for you to find Download again for slightly updated map. UPDATE: -Fixed small bugs/glitches -Fixed installer -Edited starting weapon slightly -Added Powerups/drops Have fun PS: Shoutout to ZK for awesome tutorials

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it. Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3). PROVISIONAL: archive/corpus-ignore.json was missing, so corpus boilerplate was not subtracted and this finish may be a shared-script name; scan_maps.py --keep-existing rewrites this manifest.
